nodes.label: EmbedFilter
nodes.author: Wu, Chen, Liu, Cui, Li, Yan
nodes.rationale: Removes the unembedding matrix's edge-spectrum subspace, derived analytically with no training or calibration data, since this subspace disproportionately encodes frequency-driven low-information structure.

nodes.label: Reverse-engineered average-token probe
nodes.rationale: Applies Logit Spectroscopy to an analytically reverse-engineered frequency-weighted average token rather than a real observed activation, to isolate the subspace responsible for frequency bias without running the model on real inputs.
